title: OP titles
description: A plugin that can add titles with lot of features.
body:
🏆 Op Titles
The ultimate lightweight solution for custom player prefixes and titles.
Give your players a sense of identity and prestige with Op Titles. This plugin allows administrators to create, manage, and assign unique titles to players that display prominently in chat or above their heads. Whether it's rewarding your top donors or marking your staff members, Op Titles makes it seamless.

🚀 Features
Easy Management: Simple commands to set or remove titles on the fly.
Player Choice: Let players see their available titles and choose which one to wear.
Dynamic Reloading: Update your configuration without ever restarting the server.
Lightweight: Optimized code to ensure zero impact on server performance. 


💻 Commands & Usage
/title set <player> <title> – Assign a specific title to a player.
/title remove <player> – Strip a title from a player.
/title list – View all available titles in the system.
/title equip <title> – (For players) Select from your earned titles.
/title reload – Instantly refresh the configuration file.
